title: Volterra clocks and their pure-jump limits: hitting times of curved boundaries
summary: We introduce a class of continuous Volterra processes, called Volterra clocks, and study their singular limit as the memory kernel collapses to a Dirac mass at zero. The dynamics are parametrised by a function $f$ acting as a nonlinear time-change, generalising the Volterra square-root process and recovering it when $f$ is affine. In the singular limit, the continuous Volterra clock converges weakly to a pure-jump process given by first passage times of a Brownian motion to curved boundaries, including affine and square-root boundaries when $f$ is, respectively, affine or quadratic.
